company.name: Parag Milk Foods
company.summary: The dairy business behind Gowardhan, Go, Pride of Cows, Topp Up and Avvatar.
company.description: Parag Milk Foods processes milk into consumer and institutional dairy products. It sells traditional dairy foods, cheese, beverages, premium milk and whey-based nutrition through several brands. The same milk supply can produce a mix of products with different selling prices, shelf lives and distribution needs.
company.ownership: This profile covers Parag Milk Foods Limited. Its dairy brands are different from unrelated companies that use the word Parag. Brand imagery identifies offerings and does not imply a nutritional or medical endorsement.
company.money: It earns from dairy-product sales across retail, institutional and other channels. Milk procurement costs, product mix, manufacturing efficiency and distribution determine the profit left from those sales.
watch: How fast are raw-milk costs changing relative to selling prices?
Are cheese, premium dairy and nutrition products contributing profitable growth?
How much cash is tied up in milk-powder inventory and customer credit?
risks: Seasonality and procurement competition can change input costs.
Cold-chain failures and product-quality issues can damage sales and reputation.
Dairy commodity prices can affect the value and profitability of stored products.
company.question: Why can cheese and whey nutrition change the economics of a dairy company?
company.answer: They change the mix of products obtained from milk and may earn different margins, while requiring their own processing, branding and distribution spending.
update: A milk company is also a product-mix business
Consider milk procurement, the mix of branded and institutional products, and inventory together. A popular dairy brand alone does not determine stock value.
